from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single legal document extracted for the purpose of classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document, e.g. '《判决文书1》'")
    case_type: Literal['执行案件', '民事案件', '管辖案件', '行政案件', '刑事案件', '赔偿案件'] = Field(description="The specific legal case category for this document")
    legal_basis: list[str] | None = Field(description="Laws or regulations cited that support the classification (e.g., '中华人民共和国国家赔偿法')")
    procedure_type: str | None = Field(description="The specific procedural nature mentioned in the text (e.g., '执行异议', '二审', '再审')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument]
